stories.title: Anil Ambani undertakes not to leave country pending CBI-ED probes
stories.summary: When the bench told solicitor general Tushar Mehta, who was representing both CBI and ED, to take preventive steps to ensure that investigation into the alleged fraud was not impeded, Mehta said that there was a look out circular (LOC) against Ambani, indicating that any attempt to flee the country would be foiled at the airport.

stories.title: Brazilian influencer Maria Luiza Costa da Silva dies at 18 after knife attack outside Recife bar by her boyfriend’s ex girlfriend
stories.summary: ​​Maria Luiza Costa da Silva, an 18-year-old Brazilian influencer, was stabbed to death in Recife on January 31 after an argument involving her boyfriend and his ex-girlfriend. Police say the suspect fled but was later arrested at a hospital. The case is being investigated as a homicide, according to G1 and Metrópoles.

stories.title: 'Married to daughter of Indian immigrant': Row over Republican leader saying immigration system is 'suicidal'
'At twilight of existence': 100-year-old man acquitted in murder case after 4 decades
stories.summary: A division bench of Justices Chandra Dhari Singh and Sanjiv Kumar, in a 23-page ruling dated Jan 21, tore into contradictions they found in the prosecution’s case — from unreliable testimony of two eyewitnesses to omissions in FIR and what the court called “inherent improbabilities.” Dhani Ram and co-accused Satti Din had been convicted under IPC sections 302 read with 34 for accompanying Maiku during the killing.

stories.title: Energy security of 1.4bn Indians govt’s supreme priority: Goyal in Parliament
stories.summary: ​​On choice of oil suppliers, Piyush Goyal said “Diversifying our energy sourcing in keeping with objective market conditions and evolving international dynamics is at the core of our strategy to ensure this. All of India’s actions are taken with this in mind.” The remark stood out against the backdrop of US President Donald Trump’s claims that India had decided to stop the purchase of Russian oil to secure a trade deal.

stories.title: YouTube CEO Neal Mohan praises Markiplier’s Iron Lung, calls it a new era for Hollywood
stories.summary: Markiplier's film 'Iron Lung' has taken the box office by storm. It earned over twenty million dollars on a small budget. Fans of the YouTuber flocked to see his first major movie. This success shows creator-made films can rival big studio productions. YouTube's CEO praised this achievement. It marks a significant shift for independent creators in the film industry.

stories.title: Jeff Bezos-owned Washington Post announces job cuts, eliminates sports and international coverage
‘Lots of foreigners on the beach’: Australian teen whose family was swept away in the sea struggled to get help on shore
Indian-origin trucker sent to prison for 10 years for transporting cocaine worth $5.4 million into Canada, says will regret it for the rest of life
TheBurntPeanut becomes Twitch’s most-watched streamer in January 2026
stories.summary: VTuber TheBurntPeanut has taken Twitch by storm, topping viewership charts in January 2026 with over 11.3 million hours watched. His unique peanut-headed avatar and engaging streams of games like ARC Raiders have propelled him to 1.8 million

stories.title: ‘Every minute I spent with him...’: Bill Gates breaks silence on fresh batch of Epstein files
Is Trump's Gold Card illegal? Lawsuit says scientists, engineers waiting in queues while the rich get entry
Top JeM operative among 3 shot dead in J&K ops
stories.summary: For several hours overnight, troops maintained a tight vigil using drones and ground surveillance before launching a final assault at daybreak. Both terrorists were killed in the morning operation, officials said. In Dichhar area of Kishtwar district, a suspected Pakistani terrorist was killed Wednesday evening in a running hunt across snowbound mountains.

stories.title: CM Omar tables Jan Vishwas Bill in J&K assembly; PDP accuses INDIA bloc member of breaking ranks
stories.summary: CM Omar, who also holds the charge of law, justice and parliamentary affairs, also introduced another bill — J&K Eliminating Discrimination Against Persons Affected by Leprosy Bill-2026. It seeks to amend relevant enactments to eliminate discrimination against or denial of equal treatment to persons affected by leprosy, and to prevent their segregation and exclusion.

stories.title: No breakthrough in crucial talks between Ladakh team, MHA
stories.summary: Asgar Ali Karbali, co-chairman of the Kargil Democratic Alliance, said detailed deliberations were held on statehood and the sixth schedule. “Before holding talks on these issues, we raised the issue of four youths who were ‘martyred’ in September last year and those who have been detained," he said. The first round of talks between the committee and Ladakhi representatives was held on Oct 22, 2025, in New Delhi.

stories.title: Kashmir BEd colleges face large-scale de-affiliation
stories.summary: According to the notification issued by UoK for the 2025-2027 session, only two colleges are recognised by National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) and have invited applications from eligible candidates for admission to two-year BEd programmes. Syed Masroor Andrabi, chairperson of Chinab Valley College of Education, said BEd colleges in Kashmir stood at the verge of closure.

stories.title: xQc slams Plaqueboymax after defending Aspen Kartier as animal abuse allegations spark outrage across Twitch community
stories.summary: Felix “xQc” Lengyel strongly criticized Plaqueboymax for supporting Aspen Kartier amid animal abuse allegations. Kartier was accused of harming her puppy during a Twitch stream and was later arrested in Georgia. xQc said animal abuse leaves no room for excuses, sparking wide debate across the streaming community.

stories.title: Harry Potter's villain Draco Malfoy trends in China's Lunar New Year celebrations - Here's why
'Your entire city council can be Indian': Frisco resident clashes with Indian-origin Burt Thakur on 'Indian takeover'
Trump assassination attempt case: Man convicted in Florida golf course shooting case gets life in prison
Delhi Metro completes pollution-control installations at its elevated stations: CM Gupta
CM Rekha Gupta likely to present report on first anniversary of BJP government in Delhi
Who is Vikas Nath? Indian-origin restaurant owner admits to spiking woman’s drink with ‘date-rape drug’
Enemy properties worth Rs 2930 crore sold till Jan 28, says government
‘Excellent conversation’: Trump, Xi discuss trade, Taiwan, Iran & Ukraine over phone call
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a significant phone call, addressing trade, security, Taiwan, Iran, and the Ukraine war. Trump described the discussion as "excellent" and "thorough," highlighting potential energy and agricultural deals. Both leaders emphasized the importance of maintaining a stable and positive relationship between the world's two largest economies.

stories.title: Delhi: Over 500 women screened in mega cervical cancer camp at Budh Vihar
stories.summary: In a landmark achievement for preventive healthcare, Novaneo Hospital on Wednesday entered the Guinness Book of World Records by collecting the highest number of cervical cancer (Pap/HPV) screening gut samples within an eight-hour window, underscoring the growing role of hospital-led initiatives in large-scale disease prevention.

stories.title: 'Indians came to America, and then they became...': Burt Thakur speaks on 'Indian takeover' at Frisco Council meeting
‘What will PM reply to?’ Congress reacts to PM Modi's missed LS speech; calls it pointless without LoP's address
stories.summary: Congress on Wednesday said the bigger issue in the Lok Sabha was that Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi was not allowed to speak, as the Prime Minister’s reply depends on the LoP’s questions. Without this, no debate could take place. Opposition protests led to dramatic scenes and the adjournment of the House.

stories.title: Pakistani-American businessman says denying Green Card holders govt loan bad policy: 'As a former SBA leader...'
India won't be bullied by Trump, Doval told Rubio; govt was willing to wait out US president's term, says report
stories.summary: India has finalized a significant trade deal with the US, a move that National Security Advisor Ajit Doval indicated India was willing to wait out President Trump's term for. Union Minister Piyush Goyal confirmed the agreement, emphasizing the protection of sensitive sectors like agriculture and dairy. Both nations aim to more than double trade to $500 billion by 2030.

stories.title: Tom Homan announces withdrawal of 700 immigration agents in Minnesota
stories.summary: Around 700 federal immigration officers are leaving Minnesota following increased cooperation from state and local authorities, particularly county sheriffs. White House border czar Tom Homan announced the drawdown, citing improved collaboration and a safer environment. This move comes amid protests and fatalities linked to earlier large-scale federal deployments in the state.

stories.title: 'Mover, shaker, and beggars': Pakistan's national meltdown over the India-US trade deal
stories.summary: Perhaps, Pakistan felt it had returned to its older role of indispensable intermediary as New Delhi remained the insouciant child who refused to bow to Trump’s diktats. Overnight, the illusion shattered as Trump announced the US had reached a trade agreement with India lowering tariffs on India’s exports to 18%. While most of the details about the deal are still being worked out, that didn’t stop a full-blown meltdown on Pakistani (or South Asian) Twitter.

stories.title: Rahul-Bittu spat, gherao of PM’s chair, adjournments - what happened in Parliament today
stories.summary: Parliament witnessed repeated disruptions on Wednesday as opposition protests and clashes with ruling party MPs led to multiple adjournments in the Lok Sabha. Opposition members raised allegations against Prime Minister Narendra Modi and criticized the India-US trade deal, while Union Minister Piyush Goyal defended it. Heated exchanges also occurred between Rahul Gandhi and Union Minister Ravneet Singh Bittu.

stories.title: Will file defamation case against Gaurav, other Congress leaders over land grab claim: Himanta Biswa Sarma
What happened to India-hater MAGA influencer Elijah Schaffer? Conspiracy theories abound over deleted posts on wife, kids, FBI
No PM Modi speech in Lok Sabha: What happened in a minute that led to adjournment
Operation 'Trashi-I': One terrorist killed in J&K's Kishtwar
stories.summary: Security forces neutralised one terrorist in Kishtwar during Operation 'Trashi-I'. This follows a series of encounters targeting Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammad militants. Separately, two Pakistani terrorists, including a top JeM commander, were killed in a cave in Udhampur during Operation 'Kiya', concluding a prolonged gunfight.

stories.title: Questions on caste to be notified before second phase of Census: Centre in Rajya Sabha
Rs 8,189 crore saved from cyber criminals between 2021 and 2025: Centre in Rajya Sabha
After engine fire, Turkish flight diverts safely to Kolkata
'Getting out of India such a big deal': Woman celebrating UK visa approval gets hate online; 'We will make deportation parties'
Manipur gets a taekwondo CM: Who is Yumnam Khemchand Singh
Manipur gets another BJP CM: Y Khemchand Singh sworn in after one year of President's rule
'Made me look weak’: Minnesota protester Levy Armstrong on White House’s doctored arrest photo
Why seasonal tourism creates India’s toughest waste management challenge
stories.summary: Tourist-heavy states face a different kind of pressure. A floating population generates waste, but does not stay long enough to be captured by household-style systems. The waste is scattered, time-bound, and highly visible.

stories.title: 'Could make good use of Noam’s advice': Noam Chomsky's wife asked Jeffrey Epstein to set up meeting with Donald Trump
stories.summary: Valeria Chomsky replied affirmatively. In a subsequent email the same day, she wrote that she had anticipated Trump’s rise even before the primaries and had said so publicly in meetings, lunches and dinners, but had been met with disbelief.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Rahul's 'traitor' remark against Bittu snowballs into major row; Putin, Xi hail Russia–China ties as ‘strategic’; & more
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi's 'traitor' remark against MP Ravneet Singh Bittu ignited a political firestorm, demanding an apology. Lok Sabha witnessed heated exchanges over remarks on the Gandhi family. Meanwhile, Ghaziabad mourned three sisters' deaths, with online gaming addiction a focus. The Supreme Court heard Mamata Banerjee's plea against Bengal's voter roll revision, as Putin and Xi hailed strong Russia-China ties.

stories.title: Art Basel Qatar opens in Doha: Breaks its own rules in the Gulf and the art world is watching
stories.summary: Doha hosts the inaugural Art Basel Qatar, a unique art fair designed for the MENASA region. Instead of a traditional format, it emphasizes thematic structure and deep engagement with local artistic narratives. With over half its artists from the region, the event fosters dialogue and showcases emerging talent, positioning Doha as a vital cultural bridge.

stories.title: Uttarakhand's Auli to host Skiing Winter Carnival and National Winter Games from February 13–16
Indian-origin man in New Jersey calls cops to brag about how he escaped a police chase, gets arrested
'Medical condition is not good': SC asks Centre to rethink Sonam Wangchuk's detention
Rahul Gandhi 'traitor' remark against Bittu snowballs into huge controversy, protests - top developments
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi's "traitor friend" jibe at BJP MP Ravneet Singh Bittu during a Parliament protest has sparked outrage. BJP leaders condemned the remark as unacceptable and offensive to the Sikh community, demanding an apology. Bittu retaliated, accusing Congress of atrocities against Sikhs and calling them "murderers."

stories.title: Putin calls Russia–China ties a ‘stabilising force’ in video call with Xi
stories.summary: Russian President Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping lauded their "strategic" economic partnership, emphasizing energy, nuclear power, and high-tech cooperation. The leaders affirmed mutual support for sovereignty and development paths. This high-level exchange occurs as China balances engagement with Western nations while maintaining strong ties with Moscow, despite ongoing global turbulence.

stories.title: 'Right engine caught fire': Turkish Airlines with 236 on board makes emergency landing in Kolkata
UAE to travel underground at Tesla speed? Elon Musk’s Boring Company to build Dubai Loop in most unexpected Middle East move
stories.summary: Dubai has partnered with Elon Musk's The Boring Company to construct the Dubai Loop, an underground transport system designed to significantly reduce commute times. The initial phase will feature a 6.4-kilometer pilot route connecting key districts, with the full network aiming to span over 22 kilometers and include 19 stations, transforming urban mobility.

stories.title: Oppn, BJP MPs spar in Speaker office as Nishikant Dubey flashes 'Bofors' book in LS to target Gandhi family
stories.summary: Lok Sabha witnessed heated exchanges as opposition MPs protested BJP's Nishikant Dubey targeting the Gandhi family with book references. Following adjournment, Congress MPs met Speaker Om Birla, while Union Minister Kiren Rijiju was also present. This follows earlier disruptions over former Army chief's memoir and Rahul Gandhi's disallowed quotes.

stories.title: ‘People of India have right to know’: Mallikarjun Kharge questions secrecy around US trade deal, seeks clarity in Parliament
stories.summary: Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge questioned the India-US trade deal's announcement, citing a lack of parliamentary and public consultation. He contrasted it with the transparent Indo-US civil nuclear agreement. Kharge raised concerns about potential compromises, zero tariffs on US imports, and the impact on Indian farmers and Russia oil trade, demanding full disclosure.

stories.title: Union territory with French soul: Laws that set Puducherry apart
Father, his two wives, five children - all lived together in Ghaziabad before triple death
stories.summary: Three minor sisters, aged 12, 14, and 16, died after jumping from the ninth floor of their Ghaziabad residence. Police are investigating the incident, focusing on the girls' alleged addiction to a Korean online game and excessive mobile phone use. Family members had recently restricted their phone access, reportedly causing distress.

stories.title: 'Not getting justice anywhere': Mamata takes SIR battle to SC - top developments
stories.summary: West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee urged the Supreme Court to intervene in the electoral roll revision, alleging the state is being targeted and its people bulldozed. The top court issued notices to the Election Commission and the state's chief electoral officer, emphasizing that genuine persons must remain on the electoral roll.

stories.title: Makkah hailstorm alert: Heavy rain and strong winds forecast across Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: The National Center for Meteorology issued an urgent alert for Makkah, forecasting intense winter storms with moderate to heavy thunderstorms, hail, and 60 km/h winds. Flash flood risks are high in valleys and low-lying areas, with rough seas expected along the Red Sea coast. Authorities urge extreme caution, especially for pilgrims and motorists.

stories.title: Saudi Aramco raises $4 billion: Shakes global markets, Wall Street buzzing
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia’s oil giant Saudi Aramco has successfully raised $4 billion through a bond issuance. The move highlights strong investor trust in the company's financial stability. The issuance, part of a global program, was priced in January 2026 and completed in early February 2026. Proceeds will fund capital expenditures and diversification efforts. This strengthens Aramco's financial position and boosts confidence in Saudi Arabia's economy.

stories.title: Korea-obsessed Ghaziabad sisters didn't attend school for two years, were struggling academically
stories.summary: Three minor sisters, aged 16, 14, and 12, died after jumping from their ninth-floor Ghaziabad apartment. The sisters, who had not attended school for years due to academic failure, were reportedly addicted to an online Korean task-based game. Their father stated they often expressed a desire to visit Korea, unaware of the game's nature.

stories.title: 'Slur on entire Sikh community': BJP objects to Rahul Gandhi calling Bittu 'traitor', recall 1984 riots
stories.summary: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri and Delhi minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa have strongly condemned Rahul Gandhi's 'traitor' remark against former Congress MP Ravneet Bittu. Puri defended Bittu, a respected Sikh leader, stating he is not a traitor and that Gandhi's slur is an affront to the Sikh community.

stories.title: Shashi Tharoor trips and falls at Parliament stairs; Akhilesh Yadav helps - video
'Only deletion, no inclusion': Kalyan Banerjee gives inside details of Mamata vs EC hearing in SC
stories.summary: The Supreme Court heard West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee's plea challenging the Election Commission's electoral roll revision, noting two key points in her petition. The court observed that timelines might need extension due to pending cases and issued notices to the EC and CEO for further hearing.

stories.title: India’s new customs rules bring duty-free relief on gold, electronics for UAE travellers
stories.summary: India has updated its duty-free allowance for returning residents and Indian-origin travelers to ₹75,000, including one laptop. New weight-based rules for jewelry and digitized customs processes aim to simplify travel. Passengers are advised to declare items exceeding the allowance to avoid penalties.

stories.title: '2 fell while trying to save the third': Man who saw Ghaziabad sisters jump from 9th floor at 2am
stories.summary: Three minor sisters tragically died after jumping from a ninth-floor Ghaziabad flat early Wednesday. An eyewitness reported one sister appeared to plan the jump, while the other two fell trying to stop her. Police are investigating their alleged addiction to an online gaming app and a handwritten note found at the scene.

stories.title: Big relief for UAE travellers to India: Higher duty-free limits, gold jewellery reforms, simpler baggage clearance, revamped customs rules
stories.summary: India's new customs baggage rules, effective February 02, 2026, significantly benefit international travellers, especially UAE residents and Indian expats. The duty-free allowance has been raised to ₹75,000 and value caps on gold jewellery are removed, replaced by weight limits. These modernised regulations aim to simplify procedures and enhance passenger convenience.

stories.title: Operation Kiya: Two terrorists killed by security forces in J&K's Udhampur
stories.summary: Two Jaish-e-Muhammad terrorists were neutralized in a joint operation by the Indian Army, Jammu and Kashmir Police, and CRPF in Udhampur's Basantgarh area. The intense encounter began Tuesday afternoon following specific intelligence inputs about militant movement. Security forces established contact and a firefight ensued, leading to the successful operation.

stories.title: 'Traitor' vs 'sadak ka gunda': Rahul, BJP's Bittu face off outside Parliament — Watch
stories.summary: A heated exchange occurred between Rahul Gandhi and Union Minister Ravneet Singh Bittu on Parliament steps, escalating into a political war of words. This confrontation happened amidst Opposition protests and the Lok Sabha's adjournment due to the suspension of eight MPs for disrupting proceedings.

stories.title: 'PM didn't fulfill his responsibility': Rahul displays unpublished memoir of ex-Army chief Naravane outside Parliament
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi presented excerpts from former Army Chief General MM Naravane's unpublished memoir, alleging Prime Minister Modi shirked responsibility during the 2020 Ladakh clashes. Gandhi claimed the book states the PM told the Army Chief to "do whatever he wants," leaving him feeling "alone.

stories.title: SC asks CBI, ED to conduct fair, prompt probes against ADAG, firms in banking fraud cases
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered the CBI and ED to conduct a swift and impartial investigation into alleged massive financial fraud involving the Anil Dhirubhai Ambani Group and Anil Ambani. Fresh status reports are due in four weeks.

stories.title: Ramadan 2026: UAE schools announce 12-day holiday and shorter school days
stories.summary: Ramadan 2026 sees UAE schools adopt a unique schedule, with students attending full in-person classes for only about eight days. The Ministry of Education and KHDA have prioritized spiritual reflection and family time, incorporating shorter weeks, remote learning options, and extended holidays. This approach aims to balance academic continuity with cultural observance, ensuring students can fully embrace the holy month.

stories.title: 'Love game': What is the Korean task-based app the Ghaziabad sisters were addicted to?
stories.summary: Three minor sisters, aged 16, 14, and 12, died after allegedly jumping from a ninth-floor balcony in Ghaziabad. Police are investigating the role of a Korean 'love game' they were reportedly addicted to and had refused to give up. The girls had been excessively playing the task-based game since the Covid-19 period.

stories.title: Singapore Airlines launches non-stop flights to Riyadh after 12 years: New route details, benefits explained
stories.summary: Singapore Airlines is relaunching non-stop flights to Riyadh from June 2, 2026, after a 12-year absence. Operating four times weekly on Airbus A350-900s, this service aims to boost business, tourism and cultural exchange between Southeast Asia and the Middle East. The move signifies Riyadh's growing importance as a global hub and enhances connectivity for travellers.

stories.title: Dubai set to adopt China’s ‘Sponge City’ model — What the future city could look like
stories.summary: Dubai is adopting the "Sponge City" model through a partnership with Shenzhen to enhance climate resilience and manage heavy rainfall. This initiative integrates permeable pavements, green roofs, and wetlands to absorb and purify rainwater, aiming to keep streets dry and functional while increasing urban greenery and reducing heat.

stories.title: Sharad Pawar says Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis 'was not involved' in NCP merger talks
stories.summary: Sharad Pawar stated that merger talks between Ajit Pawar and Jayant Patil occurred, asserting CM Fadnavis had no right to comment. He expressed happiness over Sunetra Pawar's Deputy CM appointment. Pawar also noted his unprecedented absence from Parliament on Budget Day due to a family tragedy, marking 58 years of attendance.

stories.title: Indian national convicted in US for sexual assault during flight
stories.summary: A federal jury in the United States has convicted Varun Arora, an Indian national living in the country without authorization, for sexually assaulting a fellow traveler onboard a domestic flight from Rhode Island to Washington D.C. in August 2024. The case highlighted the distressing nature of the assault, wherein Arora ignored the victim's pleas to stop his advances.

stories.title: Poetic protest: West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee pens 26 poems against SIR
stories.summary: West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee has authored a book of 26 poems, titled 'SIR: 26 in 26', as a literary protest against the Election Commission's intensive revision exercise. The collection, released at the International Kolkata Book Fair, expresses her resentment and alleges a "relentless campaign of fear" in Bengal.

stories.title: Gallery with café? Artist Daniel Arsham opens new art-driven coffee and dessert restaurant in Dubai Mall
stories.summary: Dubai Mall's Fashion Avenue welcomes Daniel's Room, a unique concept by artist Daniel Arsham. This space artfully blends specialty coffee, exclusive desserts and contemporary art, offering an immersive experience. More than a café, it is a cultural destination where design, objects and culinary delights intersect, inviting visitors to linger and explore.

stories.title: India releases first national lung cancer care guidelines ahead of World Cancer Day
stories.summary: India has launched its first nationally developed, evidence-based guidelines for lung cancer treatment and palliation. These guidelines aim to standardize care, improve early diagnosis, and reduce treatment gaps across the country. They offer a common clinical framework for both public and private healthcare systems, emphasizing patient-centric care and quality of life.

stories.title: 'Justice crying behind closed door': Mamata in SC leads charge against SIR
stories.summary: West Bengal chief minister and TMC supremo Mamata Banerjee approached the Supreme Court to contest the Election Commission's special intensive revision exercise. She had previously met with the Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to voice her objections, alleging humiliation during the encounter. A Supreme Court bench is set to hear the matter.

stories.title: Watch Dubai’s craziest jaw-dropping stunt: 5 men fly through world's tallest hotel at 200km/h
stories.summary: Five elite wingsuit athletes from XDubai executed a daring precision flight around the world's tallest hotel, Ciel Dubai Marina, reaching speeds over 200 km/h. The stunt, including a pass through the "eye of the needle," celebrated the hotel's grand opening and highlighted Dubai's strategy of fusing tourism, bold design and sky-high experiences.

stories.title: BJP leader Shehzad Poonawalla's mother 'deliberately' run over by car in Pune, to undergo surgery
stories.summary: BJP spokesperson Shehzad Poonawalla alleged his mother was deliberately run over by a car in Pune, leaving her seriously injured. The accused reportedly fled the scene. Poonawalla's mother is set to undergo surgery, and he has appealed to the Pune police for the swift arrest of the perpetrator.

stories.title: MHA: 364 Maoists, including 12 top leaders, killed last year; 2,337 surrendered
stories.summary: Security forces neutralized 364 Naxals, arrested 1,022, and saw 2,337 surrender last year as Left-wing extremism incidents dropped significantly. The number of affected districts has fallen to 32 from 61 since 2019, with a substantial dip in violence and casualties. The government aims to eradicate Naxalism by March 31, 2026.

MHA: Reverse migration seen in Arunachal’s ‘vibrant villages’
stories.summary: Arunachal Pradesh villages along the China border are witnessing reverse migration, a positive sign for the Vibrant Villages Programme. The initiative, aimed at boosting living conditions and livelihoods, has seen significant investment. Over 8,500 activities were conducted nationwide, with Arunachal Pradesh receiving the largest share of funds for development projects.

stories.title: Elon Musk calls Spanish PM 'dirty Sanchez' for proposing social media ban for minors
stories.summary: Elon Musk has fiercely criticized Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's proposal to ban social media for children under 16. Sanchez aims to protect minors from online harms, likening the digital space to a "wild west." This move aligns with a broader European trend towards stricter tech regulations for young users.

stories.title: Taking on the C-word, with jokes and joy
stories.summary: A new play, 'Breast of Luck,' co-written by a cancer survivor and a caregiver, uses song, dance, and humor to navigate the grim realities of illness. The musical comedy, inspired by personal experiences, highlights the therapeutic power of laughter, community, and art in confronting cancer, offering a lighter perspective on a serious topic.

stories.title: US-Iran tensions: Pakistan to be a part of Turkey-led peace talks
stories.summary: Pakistan has been invited to crucial talks in Turkey between Iran and the US, aimed at de-escalating regional tensions. Several other regional powers, including Saudi Arabia and Qatar, are also expected to attend. The discussions are anticipated to focus on Iran's nuclear program, with both sides expressing cautious optimism for a deal, though Iran warns of war if negotiations fail.

stories.title: US envoy Witkoff to hold talks with Iran; tensions rise as USS Abraham Lincoln downs Shahed drone—what we know so far
stories.summary: A US F-35C fighter jet shot down an Iranian drone approaching an American aircraft carrier, escalating tensions. This incident occurred just as Iran's president signaled a willingness for negotiations with the US. Despite the drone downing, planned diplomatic talks in Turkey are reportedly still scheduled.

stories.title: ‘My parents are immigrants...: Influencer responds after sitting through anti-ICE standing ovation
US-Russia nuclear treaty nears expiry: Why New START matters for global security
stories.summary: The world faces a dangerous new phase as the last US-Russia nuclear arms treaty, New START, is set to expire this week without a replacement. Russia warned of increased risks, noting its proposal for a one-year extension received no formal response from Washington.

stories.title: Who was Saif al-Islam Gaddafi? Son of late Libya dictator Moammar Gaddafi killed in his home
stories.summary: Saif al-Islam Gaddafi, once seen as Libya's Western-friendly reformer and heir apparent, has been killed in a direct confrontation after gunmen stormed his home. He played a key role in his father's regime, later becoming a divisive figure during the 2011 uprising. After years of detention and a death sentence, he resurfaced seeking the presidency, a bid that ultimately failed.

stories.title: Does this angel look familiar? A modern face appears in a Rome fresco
Operation Kiya: Security forces establish contact with terrorists in J&K's Basantgarh, firefight on
stories.summary: Security forces have established contact with terrorists in the Basantgarh area of Udhampur district, leading to an ongoing joint operation. The encounter began Tuesday afternoon following specific intelligence inputs, with a firefight erupting when terrorists opened fire on troops. Reinforcements have been deployed, and all exit routes sealed as the operation continues.

stories.summary: The first is the India-Pakistan re-hyphenation Trump has brought upon India through his courting of Rawalpindi. It is here US ambassador to India Sergio Gor, who seems to have found a way out of the trade impasse within weeks of arrival, may have an important role to play. Suspense still looms over his dual role as Trump’s special envoy for south Asia and any false move bracketing India with Pakistan, let alone playing sheriff, will be met with resistance.

stories.title: Wipro’s stand on dispute over ex gratia with ex-staffer abuse of law, says HC, imposes costs
stories.summary: ​​In recognition of his contribution, he was offered an ex gratia lump sum amount of Rs 6,32,000, payable after 18 months from the date of cessation of employment, subject to the condition that from the date of cessation he would not join competing companies, namely Philips India Limited or Bajaj Electricals Ltd.

SC gives bail to Chhattisgarh MLA but orders him to stay out of state

Wooing voters on caste, religion lines no ground to bar party: HC
stories.summary: A division bench of Justice Rajan Roy and Justice AK Chaudhary passed the verdict on a PIL filed by Motilal Yadav in 2013, seeking direction against holding of caste-based rallies by political parties. In an interim order in July 2013 itself, a bench of Justice Uma Nath Singh and Justice Mahendra Dayal had stayed caste-based rallies “with immediate effect” throughout UP.

stories.title: Take fresh call on CCI probe against Flipkart: SC to NCLAT
Woman not entitled to maintenance if living apart sans valid reason: HC
stories.summary: A bench headed by Chief Justice Ramesh Sinha held that the family court’s order showed no illegality or defect warranting interference by the HC. The HC noted that when the husband had filed a petition seeking restitution of conjugal rights, the woman could have returned to her matrimonial home to resume marital life.

stories.title: Praful rules himself out, Sunetra set to be NCP national chief
Judges reserving verdicts for years ‘an ailment’: Supreme Court
stories.summary: A litigant who approaches the court must get to know what judgment is given on his plea,” the CJI said. The same HC judge, Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay, was found to have kept several judgments pending for years, even in cases where the convicts had appealed against their capital and life sentences. The judge had delivered the verdicts in those cases only after SC took judicial notice of the same.

stories.title: Was Jeffrey Epstein a Russian spy? Poland's PM makes bombshell claim amid DOJ’s release of millions of files
Taekwondo master to be Manipur CM, may get 2 deputies
stories.summary: Keen to project a message of ethnic reconciliation in the north-eastern state, which was rocked by Meitei versus Kuki violence, BJP is considering appointing two deputy CMs — one each from the Kuki and Naga communities, with Singh being a Meitei. Nemcha Kipgen, a Kuki figure and former minister, is likely to be one of the deputy CMs.

stories.title: Duty relief kicks in, now you can shop a bit more while abroad
stories.summary: Used personal effects like clothes and travel souvenirs are duty-free. New goods like gifts purchases abroad qualify according to new limits. Goods above the duty-free limit are dutiable under normal customs provisions unless specifically exempted by the law. These allowances apply only to goods carried on the passenger’s person or in bona fide baggage.

stories.title: Grounded 787’s fuel control switch lock satisfactory: Govt
stories.summary: The first grounding occurred on Feb 1 after a malfunction was registered by the crew of B787 (VT-ANX) during engine start to operate flight AI-132 from London to Bengaluru. The incident was critical as the fuel control switch locking mechanism has been at the centre of the investigation into the June 12 Air India Ahmedabad crash.

stories.title: Sustained PM2.5 exposure ups depression risk: Study
stories.summary: The burden was highest among urban metro residents, people aged 40-49 years, and those from lower-income groups. Regionally, pollution-linked depression showed stronger associations in eastern India, while anxiety was more prominent in the western region. Risks also peaked during the post-monsoon season, when pollution levels typically rise. he study went beyond overall PM2.5 levels to examine individual chemical constituents of air pollution.

stories.title: All safeguards followed in Wangchuk case: Govt
stories.summary: Referring to the activist’s speech, the solicitor general said he had stated that Ladakhis could not choose their own representatives while China and Tibet etc have autonomous rights which is highly objectionable. “This is a preventive action so that he doesn’t keep repeating the things he (Wangchuk) said. The detention strikes at the very purpose for which the NSA was enacted. It will have a contextual meaning. Every state has region specific sensitivities,” Mehta said.

stories.title: Peacocks at 6,000ft spark concerns over climate change impact
stories.summary: Peacocks in Himachal Pradesh are generally found at altitudes of 1,000m but some thrive in areas up to 1,500m. Himachal Pradesh has become significantly warmer in the last 124 years. According to meteorological department, the state has recorded a rise of 1.5 degrees Celsius in average mean temperature since 1901.

stories.title: Should cops just face bullets and not fire back, asks UP CM Yogi Adityanath
stories.summary: Speaking at a pharma conclave in the city on Tuesday, he said restoring public confidence was as big a challenge as tackling crime after 2017. Yogi said he had seen how criminals mocked the law and made the people of the state suffer between 2003 and 2017, adding that law and order was his biggest challenge when PM Narendra Modi delegated the responsibility of UP to him in 2017.

stories.title: Will ban you for sharing users’ personal data, SC warns WhatsApp
stories.summary: Dealing with appeals by WhatsApp, its parent company Meta which also owns Facebook, challenging a NCLAT decision that upheld Competition Commissions finding of abuse of dominant position against the social media giant, a bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and Vipul M Pancholi scorched it with admonitions for violating right to privacy of Indian citizens.

stories.title: 8 opposition MPs suspended after chaos in Lok Sabha over ex-Army chief’s book
stories.summary: In a protest letter to Speaker Om Birla, Rahul said it was the first time the LOP was not allowed to speak on the President’s joint address, and it is a blot on democracy. The suspensions and bedlam have put a question mark on proceedings for Wednesday, when PM Narendra Modi is scheduled to reply to the motion of thanks on the President’s address.

stories.title: Jaishankar meets Rubio in Washington ahead of critical minerals ministerial meet
stories.summary: The United States is set to host the inaugural critical minerals ministerial on Wednesday (local time) in Washington DC, bringing together delegations from more than 50 countries to deepen cooperation on securing and diversifying global critical mineral supply chains, according to a notice issued earlier by the US State Department’s Office of the Spokesperson.

stories.title: Govt collects health cess, but spends less than it did earlier
stories.summary: When the health cess was introduced, the understanding was that it would boost health expenditure by topping up what the govt was already allocating. Clearly, that has not happened. Instead, cess is masking what would otherwise be a steep cut in the share of health in total Budget and in GDP. From 0.32% of the GDP in 2019, the year before Covid struck, the share has fallen to 0.27% even with the cess component.

stories.title: Adani arm ties up with Italian firm to build copters in India
stories.summary: The MoU was signed in the presence of defence secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh and A Anbarasu, DG (acquisition) in the department of defence (MoD), who called the collaboration a “strategic marriage”. It comes just a week after the Adani company and Brazilian aerospace major Embraer announced a strategic collaboration for setting up a fixed-wing aircraft manufacturing facility in India.

stories.title: Rahul claims PM is ‘under US pressure’, ‘selling away blood & sweat’ of farmers
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi said the case against Adani basically targets the PM because the business leader represents the financial structure of Modi and BJP, while the US has not yet released the full material they have on Epstein Files. “These are the two pressure points, and the country should understand that the PM is compromised,” he told reporters.

stories.title: World recognising India’s strength: PM Modi to NDA MPs
stories.summary: Addressing the BJP-led NDA parliamentary party meeting where he was felicitated for India’s trade agreements, including with EU and US, Modi said India is at the centre of an uncertain world as past alliances give way to new alignments, emphasising that the new year has been particularly encouraging for India, sources said.

stories.title: Four masked men, disabled cameras: How Muammar Gaddafi's son Saif al‑Islam was assassinated
stories.summary: Saif al-Islam Gaddafi, son of the former Libyan leader, has been killed at the age of 53 in Zintan, Libya. Masked gunmen reportedly assassinated him in his home, prompting an investigation by Libyan authorities. Gaddafi's son was once considered a successor to his father's regime and faced charges from the ICC.

stories.title: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy debuts "Let's Chat" podcast live with Cam Skattebo tomorrow
stories.summary: Twitch CEO Dan Clancy is launching the platform's first podcast, "Let's Chat," with NFL star Cam Skattebo as the inaugural guest. The live show, airing tomorrow, February 4, 2026, will explore how live streaming shapes online culture and creator stories. This initiative aims to foster deeper connections within the Twitch community, featuring bi-monthly live recordings with top streamers.

Twitch streamer and Call of Duty legend OpTic Scump welcomes first child with wife Isabelle
stories.summary: Gaming star OpTic Scump, real name Seth Abner, and his wife Isabelle joyfully welcomed their first child, baby boy Jack Jordan Abner, on January 29, 2026. The couple, married since 2023, shared their excitement with fans, who have flooded social media with congratulations. This marks a significant new chapter for the popular streamer and his family.

Texas journalist 'exposes' Indian recruiters behind 'H-1B only' job ads on LinkedIn: 'When I call the numbers...'
YouTuber Markiplier’s indie film ‘Iron Lung’ shocks the box office with a $21.7M global opening
stories.summary: Markiplier's independently made film, Iron Lung, achieved a surprising box office success, debuting at No. 2 in North America with $17.8 million. The self-financed and self-distributed movie, based on a video game, earned a global total of $21.7 million, proving that creators with strong fan support can achieve significant success without major studio backing.

stories.title: NHS introducing ‘close-relative marriage’ nurse role in UK draws backlash
stories.summary: A UK hospital's pilot role for a 'close-relative marriage nurse/midwife' in its NICU has sparked online debate. The position aims to support families with babies needing specialist care, offering genetic counselling and explaining inherited health risks. This role, linked to research on congenital conditions in offspring of related parents, has drawn varied reactions online.

'Very painful times in my marriage': Melinda French Gates reacts to newly released emails from Epstein Files
Train to Pahalgam put on hold for now as J&K govt, MPs flag threat to apple orchards

stories.summary: The Speaker further pointed out that granting statehood falls within the domain of the Centre and advised Lone to raise only those issues on which J&K govt is competent to respond or take a decision. Uttarakhand opens 83 peaks in Garhwal and Kumaon regions for mountaineering
stories.summary: Uttarakhand has unlocked 83 Himalayan peaks, including Kamet and Nanda Devi East, for mountaineering, ranging from 5,700 to 7,756 meters. Indian climbers are now exempt from expedition fees, while foreign climbers benefit from reduced state charges. A new online portal streamlines applications, boosting tourism and local employment in remote areas.

stories.title: US-Iran tensions: Tehran signals readiness for talks amid Trump's pressure
stories.summary: Iran's President Pezeshkian has ordered talks with the US, seeking an environment free from threats and unreasonable expectations, focusing on national interests. Shivam's family is devastated, demanding swift justice for the senseless loss of their only child.

stories.title: 'Considering impeachment motion': TMC plans big move against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over West Bengal SIR

stories.title: 'Blot on our democracy': Rahul Gandhi writes to Speaker Om Birla; says 'deliberate attempt' to stop him from speaking in House
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi has lodged a strong protest with Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, citing his inability to speak on the President's address. Gandhi claims he was prevented from quoting an unpublished book by former Army Chief General MM Naravane on the India-China clashes, calling it a "blot on our democracy" and a deliberate government attempt to silence him.

stories.title: 'Punjabi Devils' bike gang founder Jashanpreet pleads guilty in US in illegal possession of arms case
Qatar-based expat wins big ticket, plans heartwarming prize for his daughter

The Big Ticket draw has been a popular event for over 30 years, offering hope and significant prizes to expatriates across the Gulf.

'Take immediate action’: MEA condemns theft of Mahatma Gandhi statue in Australia

stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi hailed the India-US trade deal as a significant national benefit, while Rahul Gandhi alleged it was signed under pressure. Meanwhile, Russia intensified attacks on Ukraine's energy grid, causing widespread heating outages. In India, eight opposition MPs faced suspension from Lok Sabha for disruptive behavior. Pakistan's defence minister highlighted challenges in Balochistan amidst rising militant violence.

stories.title: MrBeast mocks Elon Musk’s SpaceX and xAI merger announcement with a cheeky tweet that sends X into a frenzy
stories.summary: MrBeast sparked online buzz after joking about Elon Musk’s announcement that SpaceX and xAI have merged into one company. Responding to Musk’s celebratory post, the YouTuber quipped about posting on a SpaceX-owned platform, sending X into a frenzy. The lighthearted jab drew widespread reactions and briefly stole attention from the $1.25 trillion merger itself.

stories.summary: Dubai is launching its revolutionary underground transport system, the Dubai Loop, in partnership with Elon Musk's The Boring Company. The project promises faster, integrated travel, with initial test runs anticipated by 2026, transforming urban mobility.

Property sales compliance is simplified, reducing administrative hurdles. Overseas travel and education remittances see reduced taxes, lowering costs. These reforms aim to boost diaspora engagement with India's economy.

stories.title: Musk’s X faces probe in France as prosecutors search office over child-abuse content, deepfakes
stories.summary: French prosecutors are conducting searches at X's Paris offices as part of an investigation into alleged child abuse material, deepfakes, and data manipulation. The accusation followed Owens’ renewed public comments about Kirk’s widow, Erika Kirk. Loomer’s post revived long standing speculation about Owens’ motives, blurring the line between political disagreement, personal grief, and unresolved tensions within conservative media circles.

IndiGo issues travel advisory amid Iran conflict: Flights to and from Tbilisi, Almaty, Baku, and Tashkent cancelled till February 28

The airline is rerouting to ensure passenger and crew safety, as its usual flight paths traverse Iranian airspace. stories.title: USA expands visa curbs to 39 countries - should UAE residents worry?
stories.summary: The U.S. Department of State has expanded visa restrictions for citizens of 39 countries deemed "non-compliant." This policy, under Section 243(d) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, impacts visitor, student, and immigrant visas. While UAE nationals are unaffected, expats from these nations residing in the UAE will face stricter rules and potential delays for U.S. travel.

stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi hailed the India-US trade deal as a significant decision benefiting all citizens. The agreement, announced by President Trump, will see the US reduce tariffs on Indian goods to 18% from 50%. India is expected to eliminate its tariffs and non-tariff barriers on US products, potentially boosting trade significantly.

stories.title: Inside China’s gray zone activities: How Beijing is salami slicing its way to influence
stories.summary: China is employing a 'salami slicing' strategy, taking incremental steps across military, economic, and technological domains to alter realities without triggering conflict. This 'gray zone' approach, evident in the South China Sea and beyond, bypasses international law and exploits rivals' hesitation. The cumulative effect creates new facts on the ground, challenging the existing order.

stories.title: Piers Morgan reacts strongly as Candace Owens podcast sparks outrage over Erika Kirk jokes and Charlie Kirk theories
stories.summary: Piers Morgan condemned Candace Owens and Bassem Youssef after comments about Erika Kirk sparked backlash online. He continues to challenge Owens to prove her claims or publicly retract them.

stories.summary: Appearing for social activist Akash Goel, advocate Mukta Gupta told a bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi that the directorate of census operations, which has commenced preparatory work for Census 2027, has not disclosed “any predetermined criteria or standardised methodology” for recording caste identity of people belonging to SC, ST and OBC categories during census.

They were allegedly involved in tampering of evidence by swapping blood samples of their kids with their own. Father of the main accused, who is a minor and was allegedly driving the case, is still in jail.

stories.summary: Days that once revolved around work, cuddles and caring for her breastfeeding child are now spent in a hospital bed, recovering from a brutal dog attack that has left her with more than 80 stitches across her face, throat and head — and scars that go far beyond the physical. Early on Jan 26, Shalini had stepped out for morning walk near home in HSR Layout’s Teachers’ Colony.

stories.title: Wangchuk tried to create Nepal and Bangladesh-like unrest: Govt tells SC
stories.summary: Appearing before a bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and P B Varale, solicitor general Tushar Mehta said the activist was appealing to Gen Z to come out on the street against govt to create a problem in Ladakh which is very sensitive as it shares borders with countries that are not very friendly. Responding to Wangchuk’s submission that he was holding a peaceful protest against govt on the line of Gandhian principles, the SG said, “Gandhi was just a facade to hide his real intention of instigating violence.”

stories.title: Stanford students pretend to be Jains to escape $7,944 mandatory meal plan
stories.summary: A Stanford student's essay alleging undergraduates falsely claim Jain identity to bypass mandatory meal plans has sparked debate. This controversy highlights broader student frustration with expensive, inflexible campus dining and the challenges universities face in balancing accommodations with potential misuse.

stories.title: SC notice to govt as church body challenges anti-conversion laws
stories.summary: One of the laws challenged by the association is the nearly 60-year-old Orissa Freedom of Religion Act, 1967. Madhya Pradesh had enacted Chhattisgarh Dharma Swatantrya Adhiniyam in 1968 to prevent large-scale conversion of tribals. SC had upheld the constitutional validity of the Orissa and MP laws in 1977 in Rev Stanislaus vs State of MP case and said while the right to propagate religion is a fundamental right, it does not include right to convert.

stories.summary: Official sources said BJP MLAs are in the national capital and will be electing a new leader, who will be sworn in as the new chief minister. stories.title: TMC vs EC: Poll body red flags abusive language by Trinamool MLAs
stories.summary: While also listing blatant violations of EC’s lawful directions by the Bengal administration, CEC Gyanesh Kumar on Monday firmly conveyed to Mamata that the “rule of law shall prevail and anybody taking law into their own hands shall be dealt with strictly, as per provisions of law and powers vested in the Commission”. “No pressure, obstruction, or interference of any kind by anyone should be exerted on officers engaged in SIR work,” it was underlined.

stories.title: Bengal SIR row: Didi storms out of meet with CEC, claims being ‘humiliated’
stories.summary: Talking to reporters later in front of Nirvachan Sadan — where a heavy police posse had gathered — she claimed to have warned the CEC that he will end up like Jagdeep Dhankhar, seen as a reference to the former VP’s sudden resignation last year. She was accompanied by party national general secretary Abhishek Banerjee, MP Kalyan Banerjee, and 12 members from what they claimed were “SIR-affected families” from Bengal.

stories.title: 12-yr-old lured into trading Rs 85L jewellery for ‘unlimited momos’
stories.summary: According to a complaint filed by the boy’s father, a temple priest, the child had grown fond of momo sold at the roadside stall. The vendors allegedly began feeding him free of cost, winning trust bite by bite. Soon came bigger offers — food, small sums of money, loyalty. Then persuasion. Unaware of the stakes, the boy began removing jewellery from home and handing it over, police said.

Allegations remain unproven.

stories.title: Gen Naravane's memoir: Rules bar retired officers from publishing classified info
stories.summary: Senior military officials, particularly those dealing with classified information, are subject to regulations under the Official Secrets Act that restrict the publication of books or information even after retirement to prevent such classified material from becoming public. While a general one-year “cooling-off” period exists for taking up commercial or private employment, regulations for publishing secret content require prior govt clearance.

stories.title: Rahul quotes from ex-Gen’s unpublished book on China row, gets Shah, Rajnath rap

stories.title: ‘No mechanical arrests over social media posts’: SC upholds HC order
stories.summary: The SC order may end the prevalent practice harassing people by filing mulitple cases against those whose social media post is critical of govt or party in power, and safeguards fundamental rights. The guidelines say the police must verify whether the complainant qualifies as the “person aggrieved” in terms of law before registering a case and conduct a preliminary probe before lodging an FIR.

stories.title: 'Ours will be greatest of them all!' Trump shares photo of 'beautiful' India Gate
Manipur to get new govt soon? BJP's Tarun Chugh appointed central observer for election of state legislature party leader
stories.summary: The BJP is poised to form the government in Manipur, with senior leader Tarun Chugh appointed as central observer to facilitate the election of the legislature party leader. This development follows the summoning of BJP-led NDA legislators to the national capital. Manipur has been under President's rule since February 2025, following ethnic violence.

stories.title: 'Illegal gold melting setup': What police found inside two Indian jewelry stores in Texas linked with $55 million fraud
‘Not trying to defame the Army’: Priyanka Gandhi defends Rahul Gandhi amid Lok Sabha standoff over Naravane memoir
stories.summary: Priyanka Gandhi Vadra defended her brother, Rahul Gandhi, stating he quoted from a magazine referencing former Army Chief Naravane's memoir, not defaming the Army. The Lok Sabha saw disruptions and adjournment as Gandhi insisted on discussing border tensions, prompting objections from BJP members who accused him of flouting rules and demoralizing forces. Gandhi maintained national security is paramount.

stories.title: 'Misbehaved, thumped table and left': EC hits back at Mamata's fiery attack on poll chief over SIR
'Sonam Wangchuk tried to provoke Gen Z': Centre's massive 'Nepal-Bangladesh' charge in Supreme Court
stories.summary: Environmental activist Sonam Wangchuk, detained under NSA, is accused by the Centre of inciting Ladakh's youth for protests inspired by regime-toppling movements. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta told the Supreme Court that Wangchuk's speeches, referencing Nepal, Bangladesh, and the Arab Spring, aimed to create a rift between the people and the government. The court is hearing a challenge to his detention.

stories.title: What is Tulsi Gabbard hiding? A whistleblower keeps pushing a secret complaint Congress hasn’t seen
stories.summary: A classified whistleblower complaint against Tulsi Gabbard has been held by her agency for eight months, sparking concerns over secrecy rules and oversight. The Intelligence Community Inspector General is reviewing the allegations, but extreme classification is reportedly blocking its transmission to Congress. This delay raises questions about accountability for senior intelligence officials.

stories.title: Air India grounds a Dreamliner after pilot reports 'possible defect' in fuel control switch on landing in Bengaluru from London
stories.summary: Air India has grounded a Boeing 787 Dreamliner after its crew reported a fuel control switch issue post-landing. This follows a 2025 crash where a similar switch malfunction led to engine failure. The airline is investigating with the manufacturer, while aviation regulators are also probing the incident, raising safety concerns.

stories.title: 'Why are you here then?': Indian-origin race discrimination commissioner calls Australia 'stolen land', faces backlash
Iran offers nuclear talks to US after Donald Trump's 'time is running out' ultimatum
Jinn in custody? Pakistan police register case against supernatural spirits for child abduction
Did Trevor Noah just admit to insider trading on the Grammys stage? The ‘potato’ joke explained
stories.summary: Trevor Noah’s unscripted “potato” joke at the Grammys name-checked Polymarket and caught the attention of crypto bettors, despite no such wager existing. The line turned a niche prediction market into a live-TV reference, sparking online debate and fast clip circulation across crypto and entertainment circles during the broadcast and across social platforms within minutes.

stories.title: Trump fumes over Trevor Noah’s Epstein Island joke at the Grammys: 'Sending my lawyers’
Evening news wrap: Parliament witnesses showdown as Rahul quotes Naravane memoir; Sanjay Raut calls Ajit Pawar’s death ‘suspicious’; & more
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi's Lok Sabha speech ignited a storm by quoting an unpublished Army chief memoir, leading to protests. Mamata Banerjee clashed with Delhi Police over alleged bias. Sanjay Raut questioned Ajit Pawar's plane crash death, demanding a probe. Meanwhile, a Bangladesh court jailed ex-PM Sheikh Hasina, and China criticized the Dalai Lama's Grammy win.

stories.title: 'Arrogant, liar': Mamata attacks EC chief after SIR meet, asks why Bengal being targeted
stories.summary: West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee hit out at CEC Gyanesh Kumar and called him 'arrogant' and 'liar' post meeting. The remarks came amid the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in West Bengal. Banerjee and her party Trinamool Congress have called the exercise as biased, discriminatory and politically motivated.

stories.title: 'Running on a platform of shutting down temples': Hindu leader says Republican loss in Texas local election not surprising
Epstein Files: Is Mira Nair's former husband Mitchell Epstein related to Jeffrey Epstein? Is Zohran Mamdani named?
stories.summary: From that single line, a web of insinuation has been spun. Surnames have been confused. Family histories misread. Her son has been dragged into a narrative that has nothing to do with him. What remains, once the noise recedes, is a story far narrower and far more ordinary than the rumours suggest.

stories.title: 'PM ran away from decisions': Rahul attacks Centre; cites ex-Army chief Narvane's account of Galwan clash
“Easy million dollars”: Clavicular mocks boxing culture before cashing in on Andrew Tate’s offer
stories.summary: Andrew Tate has reignited influencer boxing controversy by backing a potential Misfits Boxing fight between Bryce Hall and streamer Clavicular with a seven-figure offer. Clavicular, who previously mocked boxing and dismissed fighting as pointless, quickly changed course once money was involved. Hall accepted immediately, turning online taunts into serious negotiations.

stories.title: 'Flouted rules, wasted time': BJP attacks Rahul Gandhi for trying to quote ex-Army chief Naravane's memoir; Congress hits back
Herof 2.0 explained: Balochistan is exploding again - and why it matters for Pakistan and world
stories.summary: Pakistan faces a deepening security crisis in Balochistan as the Baloch Liberation Army escalates its campaign through "Operation Herof. This surge impacts Pakistan's economy, foreign relations, and investor confidence. The region's strategic importance, particularly for China's Belt and Road Initiative and mineral resources, is now under strain.

stories.title: Sheikh Hasina convicted again: B'desh court hands 10-yr sentence in housing scam cases
stories.summary: A Bangladesh court has handed former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina a 10-year prison sentence in two corruption cases concerning plot allocations. Her niece, British MP Tulip Siddiq, received a four-year sentence. The convictions stem from alleged irregularities in the Purbachal New Town project. Hasina, living in exile, faces multiple other convictions.

stories.title: India-UAE travel gets budget-friendly: Air India Express launches mega sale with flight tickets under Dh350
stories.summary: Air India Express has launched a massive sale, slashing one-way fares between the UAE and India to as low as AED 320 for travel throughout 2026. This promotion, offering over five million seats, aims to make trips more affordable for millions of expatriates and budget travellers. The sale includes flexible booking options, encouraging early planning for holidays and family visits.

stories.title: Elon Musk said he rebuffed Jeffrey Epstein. The emails tell a different story...
stories.summary: Between late 2012 and the end of 2013, Musk and Epstein exchanged multiple emails discussing island visits, parties, schedules, and logistics. Some plans fell through. Others were cancelled. But the emails show Musk actively engaging in conversations about going.

stories.title: 'Can't India–China ties be discussed in House?' Mahua Moitra jabs Centre after Rahul Gandhi raises ex-Army chief memoir
stories.summary: TMC MP Mahua Moitra criticised the Centre for labeling the Opposition as unpatriotic and restricting discussions on crucial foreign relations. The Parliament Budget Session saw heated exchanges when Rahul Gandhi attempted to quote from former Army Chief Naravane's unpublished memoir, which was disallowed by the Lok Sabha Speaker, escalating tensions.

stories.title: Congress vs Tharoor: A new beginning or temporary truce?
stories.summary: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor has affirmed his commitment to the party and will actively campaign for the UDF in Kerala's upcoming assembly elections. Following a meeting with party leaders, Tharoor stated that differences were exaggerated and all are now on the same page. The Kerala Congress has also confirmed his prominent role in the election campaign.

stories.title: Big Ticket Abu Dhabi reveals Dh15 million jackpot, weekly wins for February
stories.summary: Big Ticket Abu Dhabi's Series 260 offers a massive Dh15 million jackpot on March 3, 2026. February is already showering cash with daily e-draws, crowning a new winner every 24 hours. Indian expat Hakkim Sha Habeeb was the first to win Dh50,000. Luxury car giveaways also add to the excitement this month.

stories.title: Russia witnessed ‘four moons’ over St. Petersburg in an unusual sky display, leaving stargazers speechless | Watch
Operation CyStrike: CBI launches cyber fraud crackdown; dismantles crime networks targeting foreigners from India
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation, in a multinational crackdown dubbed 'Operation CyStrike' with international law enforcement agencies, targeted transnational cyber-enabled financial crime networks. Searches across India led to the dismantling of networks defrauding victims in India and five other countries: The US, UK, Singapore, Kuwait, and Ireland.

stories.title: Epstein Files: 3 sacred pieces of Kaaba cloth shipped to US Virgin Islands
stories.summary: Shocking Epstein Files reveal three sacred Kiswa pieces from Makkah's Kaaba were shipped to the convicted sex offender in 2017. Arranged via UAE-linked contacts, the sacred cloth, described as 'artwork' for customs, has sparked outrage and debate over religious respect and the handling of holy artefacts. The motive behind the shipment remains unexplained.

stories.title: ‘Not a religious person’: China firmly opposes Grammy award to Dalai Lama
Will Saudi Arabia schools stay open in Ramadan 2026? Ministry of Education new rules explained
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Education has outlined attendance rules for Ramadan 2026, ensuring schools remain open with adjusted timings to support fasting students. While emphasizing academic continuity, the ministry plans a 28-day break, including the Eid al-Fitr holiday, to balance spiritual observance with learning. Strict adherence to schedules is mandated.

stories.title: Dubai Metro fines explained: How to avoid Dh100 to Dh2,000 penalties for rule violations
stories.summary: Dubai Metro has enforced strict fines from Dh100 to Dh2,000 for rule breaches. These penalties cover everything from eating and smoking to safety violations. The Roads and Transport Authority aims to ensure passenger safety and a smooth commuting experience. Compliance with rules is crucial for the Metro's reliability and efficiency.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi vs Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh: Parliament showdown over ex-Army chief Naravane memoir — how it unfolded
stories.summary: Lok Sabha witnessed a heated exchange as Rahul Gandhi quoted from former Army chief General MM Naravane's unpublished memoir during the Motion of Thanks. Union ministers Amit Shah and Rajnath Singh objected, citing parliamentary rules against citing unpublished material. Gandhi defended his reference, stating it pertained to the Prime Minister's character.

stories.title: NASA shows iceberg A-23A turns Blue: One of Antarctica’s oldest giants
KNMA’s global moment: Louvre Abu Dhabi’s Manuel Rabaté to lead Kiran Nadar museum
'Restrain yourself from atrocities': Mamata Banerjee vs Delhi Police ahead of CEC meet over SIR
stories.summary: West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee arrived in Delhi for a meeting with the Election Commission amid political tension. She protested a heavy police presence outside Banga Bhavan, comparing the treatment to that of Union home minister Amit Shah's visits to West Bengal. Banerjee vowed to fight against alleged atrocities and harassment of people from Bengal.

stories.title: 'A total loser': Trump lashes out at Trevor Noah over Epstein Island joke at Grammy Awards; threatens to sue him
stories.summary: President Donald Trump has threatened to sue comedian Trevor Noah for defamation after Noah joked during the Grammy Awards that Trump visited Epstein Island with Bill Clinton. Trump vehemently denied the accusation on Truth Social, calling Noah a "talentless dope" and vowing to send his lawyers after him.

stories.title: 'I have been further linked' to Epstein: Ex-UK minister Peter Mandelson resigns from Labour Party
stories.summary: Former British ambassador Peter Mandelson has quit the Labour Party following renewed scrutiny over his links to Jeffrey Epstein. Newly released US documents allege Epstein made payments totaling $75,000 to Mandelson in the early 2000s. Mandelson, who has no recollection of these transfers, stated he doesn't want to cause further embarrassment to the party while he investigates the claims.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia suspends 1,800 Umrah travel agencies for poor service
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Hajj and Umrah suspended 1,800 foreign travel agencies due to service quality and compliance issues. Pilgrims with existing visas are unaffected but agencies have 10 days to rectify problems or face further action. This move aims to enhance the Umrah sector's reliability and protect pilgrim rights.

stories.title: Flying taxis in downtown Dubai? Residents get a shock preview near Dubai Mall
stories.summary: Dubai is set to launch commercial air taxi operations in early 2026, connecting key vertiports and offering a swift alternative to ground travel. This initiative aims to create an integrated urban air transport system, with initial pricing expected to be premium but with a long-term goal of affordability.

stories.title: UAE weather forecast: Will fog, rain disrupt commute?
stories.summary: Residents and visitors in the UAE can expect a mix of humidity-driven fog and pleasant daytime warmth on February 02, 2026. The National Centre of Meteorology forecasts partly cloudy skies with a chance of light rainfall in some areas. Motorists are advised to drive with caution due to potential low visibility in the early morning hours.

stories.title: Trump's $100,000 H-1B fee: Is the US shutting Indian talent out?
stories.summary: Sweeping US immigration and trade policies, particularly the H-1B visa fee hike to $100,000, are straining the strategic partnership with India. This has disrupted Indian professionals' careers, impacting IT giants and creating anxiety. Critics argue these protectionist measures undermine innovation and alienate a key partner, potentially boosting India's domestic tech sector.

stories.title: Qatar's 10-year residency dream: A new golden opportunity for entrepreneurs and CEOs
stories.summary: Qatar unveils a 10-year residency program for global founders, investors, and executives, moving beyond traditional sponsorship. This initiative, part of the "Mustaqel" framework, aims to attract significant economic contributors. Eligible individuals can self-sponsor, bring families, and own property, fostering long-term commitment and innovation within the nation's growing business ecosystem.

stories.title: 'Something happened behind the curtains': Sanjay Raut raises grave doubts on Ajit Pawar's death
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut has raised suspicions regarding the death of NCP leader Ajit Pawar in a plane crash, calling it "dubious" and demanding a thorough investigation. Raut alleged that Pawar was seeking reconciliation with his uncle Sharad Pawar and faced pressure over the irrigation scam, drawing parallels to the Justice Loya case.

stories.title: 'You’re 100% lying': Internet explodes as Bryan Johnson defends Epstein encounter
stories.summary: Tech entrepreneur Bryan Johnson has sparked online debate after revealing a brief, unsettling Zoom encounter with Jeffrey Epstein eight years ago. Johnson described an immediate sense of unease, ending the call and severing contact. While some defend his instincts, critics question the timing and his narrative, highlighting the ongoing scrutiny of elite networks.

stories.title: Ramadan 2026: Will the month of fasting begin from Wed, Feb 18 or Thurs, Feb 19?
stories.summary: Muslims worldwide are anticipating 2026 Ramadan's start with great pomp and show. Do astronomical calculations point to Wednesday, February 18 or Thursday, February 19, 2026, as the most likely first day in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and many other nations? Here's what the local moon sightings, the blend of tradition and science favours for the holy month of fasting and reflection.

stories.title: Kennedy Center to shut for 2 years: Trump orders closure for renovations; effective July 4
'We'll find out whether Khamenei was right': Trump reacts to Iran's 'regional war' warning
stories.summary: President Trump expressed hope for a deal with Iran, warning that failure could lead to conflict, as Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei threatened a regional war if provoked. Trump highlighted the US military presence, while Khamenei accused the US of seeking to dominate Iran due to its resources and strategic location, referencing past US influence.

stories.title: ‘We know about your mom’: Zohran Mamdani faces heat over Epstein row; supporters heckle NYC mayor at home
stories.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani faced voter protests at his home following the release of new Jeffrey Epstein-related documents. These records mention his mother, filmmaker Mira Nair, in connection with a 2009 social event hosted by Ghislaine Maxwell. Protesters expressed anger and disappointment, questioning Mamdani's integrity after having supported him.

stories.title: Epstein row: Elon Musk denies links; rejects ‘creepy island’ and ‘Lolita Express’ claims
stories.summary: Tech billionaire Elon Musk has denied any connection to Jeffrey Epstein. Musk stated he never visited Epstein's island, attended his parties, or flew on his plane. His denial comes after his name surfaced in recently released Epstein case documents. Musk emphasized his support for full document disclosure and prosecution of abusers, even if it leads to personal attacks.
