4.7 magnitude earthquake hits Jammu and Kashmir's Baramulla
Clip of unnatural act with cow sparks mob violence
Archaeologists uncover tunnels inside 6000-year-old Neolithic site in Germany
Rail coach goes missing, travellers left holding bags
stories.summary: Passengers holding confirmed tickets for a 3AC coach on Sambalpur–Nanded Nagavali Superfast Exp discovered Sunday morning that their coach was missing when train 20809 rolled into Sambalpur, 320km west of Bhubaneswar. Sorcar’s act relied on lighting, timing and crowd control. This one needed none of that — just confirmed tickets, an absent coach and a reminder that on Indian Railways, reality can outdo illusion.

stories.title: ‘Hum hain na,’ PM Modi assures followers of Guru Ravidas
stories.summary: PM Modi addressed the followers at Dera Sachkhand Ballan soon after naming Adampur airport after the social reformer on his birth anniversary, lauding his message of equality. “I am confident that we will continue to strengthen the roots of our society with these efforts,” he said in a message of unity to the poet-saint’s followers. His inclusion of Ravidas in the saffron tent of its lodestars, where Lord Ram sits alongside revered saints, is being seen as his effort to deepen BJP’s connect and broaden its cultural appeal.

stories.title: Alex Pretti shooter Jesus Ochoa is a gun enthusiast with 25 rifles, pistols and shotguns, reveals ex-wife
Man bought 240 Land Rover Defenders worth £8 million on borrowed money and made insane returns
stories.summary: When Land Rover ended Defender production, Twisted Automotive founder Charles Fawcett made a high-risk bet, buying 240 new vehicles on borrowed money. Rather than flip them, he rebuilt each as a bespoke luxury restomod. As demand surged, prices soared into six figures, turning the gamble into a project worth more than £50 million and reshaping the company’s future.

stories.title: Who is Basil Ass’ad? 20-year-old charged in 48 vehicle break-ins in Canada, thefts valued at over $250,000
Elected govt in Manipur soon? NDA MLAs from hill state summoned to Delhi
Who are Jesus Ochoa and Raymundo Gutierrez? Federal agents identified as shooters of Alex Pretti
With Moltbook, AI agents build their own civilisation
stories.summary: The platform looks like Reddit with a haircut: only verified AI agents may speak. Humans are spectators as algorithms trade coding tips, argue about identity, complain about their owners and, with straight-faced enthusiasm, establish a mock faith called “Crustafarianism” or “Church of Molt”. One agent even wonders aloud whether it can sell “my human” in the open market.

stories.title: KCR made to read Telegraph Act during 5-hour questioning
stories.summary: The SIT sleuths — led by S M Vijay Kumar, joint commissioner of police (special branch) — also asked KCR why the BRS govt retained T Prabhakar Rao as chief of Special Intelligence Bureau (SIB) even after retirement. Prabhakar Rao was named as prime accused in the case by Hyderabad police in 2024, after Congress assumed office.

stories.title: Shots fired at Rohit Shetty home in Mumbai, 4 held
Piyush triggers flutter in NCP with ‘Praful is chief’ faux pas
'Immigration should not…': Canadian lawyer says fertility rate is at all-time low and mass migration is not the solution
If merger talks were on, Ajitdada would have told us: CM Fadnavis
Hindu Canadian Foundation protests in −23°C against violence targeting religious minorities in Bangladesh
Twitch streamer PlaqueBoyMax opens up about lust addiction and quitting weed
stories.summary: Popular streamer PlaqueBoyMax has bravely revealed his struggles with lust addiction and a desire to quit marijuana use. He shared his personal journey towards self-improvement with his online audience, aiming to inspire others facing similar challenges. This candid confession has resonated widely, highlighting the human side of online personalities and sparking conversations about mental health.

stories.title: Drunk passenger who jumped 100 feet off cruise ship recounts ‘cement-like’ impact in shark-infested waters
stories.summary: Nick Naydev, 27, survived a 100-foot jump from the Symphony of the Seas while docked in the Bahamas, despite severe risk and alcohol influence. The stunt, filmed by friends, sparked outrage and a permanent Royal Caribbean ban. Naydev later described the painful impact and dangerous waters, warning others against reckless behavior and the thin line between thrill-seeking and fatal risk.

stories.title: Popular rapper and Twitch streamer Snoop Dogg’s daughter Cori announces heartbreaking loss of newborn daughter
stories.summary: Snoop Dogg's daughter, Cori Broadus, has announced the tragic passing of her daughter, Codi, who was born three months premature. Codi spent most of her short life in the NICU. Despite recent moments of joy after returning home, the family is devastated by the loss, receiving widespread condolences and support.

stories.title: Indian manager teaching maths while serving food in Taco Bell: US immigration expert says 'diversity is strength'
Zohran Mamdani appoints ex-prisoner to lead NYC’s jail system – Who is Stanley Richards?
Tectone Loses Civil Court Case Filed by Ex-Girlfriend Pinkchyu in Texas
stories.summary: Streamer Tectone has lost a civil protective order case filed by his ex-girlfriend Pinkchyu. A Texas court granted Pinkchyu a 10-year protective order against Tectone. The order restricts contact and requires Tectone to maintain distance. This civil ruling does not involve criminal charges. Tectone publicly acknowledged the outcome, noting the difference in civil proceedings.

stories.title: ‘Indians dumping trash in fields’: MAGA commentator says Frisco residents are ‘sick of it’ amid ‘Indian takeover’ row
MP Rashid’s party seeks citizenship for ex-militants’ kin from PoK
Hunt for ultras intensified on Day 15 of Op Trashi-I
Dismissed as piles: Fit 31-year-old warns against ‘silent’ cancer symptoms after ‘big, ominous’ tumour found
stories.summary: Chris Kirt, a 31-year-old father diagnosed with stage two bowel cancer, shares his journey from dismissing early, subtle symptoms to undergoing surgery and achieving remission. Highlighting night sweats, fatigue, and changes in bowel habits, he now raises awareness of bowel cancer’s “silent” signs, especially in younger adults, encouraging vigilance, early detection, and self-advocacy in medical care.

stories.title: Mamata Banerjee moves Supreme Court against Bengal SIR; Election Commission and state poll body made parties in case
'Alternative govt': Shashi Tharoor on his vision of Congress' role; dismisses rift rumours
Prince Andrew’s ex-wife Sarah Ferguson told Epstein ‘just marry me’ after he was released from jail
stories.summary: Newly released emails reveal Sarah Ferguson maintained contact with Jeffrey Epstein for years after his 2008 conviction for soliciting a minor. The correspondence, extending into at least 2011, shows Ferguson offering VIP access to royal properties and expressing affectionate sentiments towards Epstein, despite his criminal record and public scrutiny.

stories.title: Killing of stray dogs continues in Telangana village, case booked
Royal wedding ritual sparks Sikh sensitivity debate, SAD Amritsar chief Mann’s grandson issues public apology
stories.summary: A wedding ceremony in Simranjit Singh Mann's family sparked debate after a video showed religious symbols like the Chaur and Chhatar being used for an individual. Critics argued this disrespects Sri Guru Granth Sahib, the sole recipient of such reverence. The groom later apologized, acknowledging the mistake and emphasizing the sanctity of the Guru Granth Sahib.

stories.title: Farmers left empty-handed despite Budget hopes: BKU Charuni
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) Charuni has strongly criticized the Union Budget 2026-27, deeming it anti-farmer and detached from ground realities. The union highlighted the budget's focus on technology over pressing farmer issues like MSP, rising costs, and loan waivers, calling the PM-Kisan assistance a mockery.

stories.title: 'He shared everything with me': Fadnavis rubbishes speculations over merger of NCP after Ajit Pawar's death
stories.summary: Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis expressed surprise regarding any potential merger talks between NCP factions, stating Ajit Pawar always confided in him. This follows Sharad Pawar's claim that Ajit Pawar had set February 12 for a merger announcement. Ajit Pawar's wife, Sunetra Pawar, was recently sworn in as Deputy CM.

stories.title: If you bought just $1 of Bitcoin when it launched 17 years ago, how rich would you be today?
stories.summary: Bitcoin’s early years read like financial folklore. Launched in 2009 as a fringe experiment, it was dismissed, ignored, or casually spent. Yet tiny sums once worth dollars would today equal millions or billions. From lost hard drives to legendary pizza purchases, Bitcoin’s history is defined less by complexity than by scale, and how easily it was missed.

stories.title: Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan unveils Dh500m Umm Suqeim Beach makeover
stories.summary: Dubai is investing Dh500 million to transform Umm Suqeim 1 Beach into a world-class, sustainable urban destination. Approved by H.H. Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, the project aims to boost public beach length by 400% and offer 24/7 enjoyment with advanced facilities, enhancing quality of life and tourism.

stories.title: Budget blueprint for Viksit Bharat, says Yogi; Akhilesh calls it 'invisible ledger' of BJP's corruption
stories.summary: As the Union Budget 2026-27 rolled out, Uttar Pradesh's political figures showcased strikingly different perspectives. Yogi Adityanath, the Chief Minister, embraced the budget as a vehicle for welfare, promoting a prosperous future for India that uplifts youth, farmers, and businesses alike.

stories.title: ‘Miyas will face trouble as long as I am CM’: Himanta Sarma unmoved by backlash
Union Budget a step towards realising PM's vision of Viksit Bharat: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta
stories.summary: Delhi's Chief Minister Rekha Gupta celebrated the Union Budget as a pivotal move towards fulfilling Prime Minister Modi's dream of a 'Viksit Bharat'. She praised the budget's focus on inclusivity, which promises to enhance opportunities for the youth, preserve cultural legacies, promote sports, and strengthen vital services.

stories.title: "Budget for Developed India-2047": Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami lauds Union Buget 2026-27
stories.summary: Dhami highlighted Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership and said the budget reflects today's needs and the vision for the future. Dhami noted that the budget provides opportunities to every section of society, ensuring their upliftment and said that it will "strengthen social balance and inclusive development."

stories.title: Adin Ross Calls For Proof: Streamer urges transparency in TeamWater; MrBeast yet to respond
stories.summary: Adin Ross questioned the transparency of MrBeast’s TeamWater initiative during a January 30 livestream, saying high-profile charity projects need visible proof and regular updates. While denying he was calling the project a scam, Ross argued that silence invites skepticism. He compared the situation to Kai Cenat’s Africa school project, stressing that public accountability helps prevent backlash.

stories.title: ‘Long lost cave in New Zealand’ reveals million-year-old wildlife, extinct birds, and a Kākāpō ancestor
